correctness.rationale: The 120-bit signature is by definition the set of nonempty length<=4 scattered subsequences. The precise append recurrence S(wa)=S(w) union {a} union {ua: u in S(w), |u|<=3} is an equality both ways. Because each of 3 possible append transitions is evaluated for EVERY reached state, a BFS that exhausts its queue visits the entire finite quotient, and first distance is the minimal representative length. I independently reimplemented the 120-bit automaton transition, BFS, and symmetry actions rather than relying on the package's expected histogram; obtained exactly 334202 states and 1002606 transitions with maximum depth 18, 18 extremals and disjoint six-state orbits covering them. Depth histogram independently matched every one of 19 levels. Independent position-combination oracle and published ranker criterion in checked package provide separate witness checks. Exhaustion is genuine transition closure, not incomplete search.

The finite closure rests on precise semantics and a completed enumeration; it is not a formula for unbounded alphabet or level.
